scope: Actual local event queue and file-backed SQLite; publisher account disabled after enqueue and committed before consumer is scheduled.
verified: Disabled publisher cannot persist queued approval.
No pending approval row or memory request survives.
Active-account baseline still creates exactly one valid approval and rejects forged applicant.
limitations: Account deactivation only; session logout/revocation and tenant membership changes are not covered.
No remote queue or installed application acceptance.
